plugins.name: va-medicaid-work-requirement
plugins.description: Unofficial, plain-language help for Virginia's federal Medicaid work requirement (Medicaid Expansion adults, starting 2027): exemption screener, notice decoder, and hours/income tracker. Not affiliated with DMAS or the Commonwealth of Virginia. General information only, not eligibility decisions or legal advice.

skills.name: am-i-affected
skills.description: Screens whether Virginia's new federal Medicaid work requirement (starting 2027 for Medicaid Expansion adults 19-64) likely applies to a person, by asking one question at a time and checking exclusions and exceptions first. Use when a navigator, social worker, legal aid advocate or Medicaid member asks "does the work requirement apply to me/my client?", "am I exempt?", or similar about Virginia Medicaid.
headings: Am I affected? Virginia Medicaid work requirement screener
Before you start: read the references
Step 1: New applicant or current member?
Step 2: Is the person in Medicaid Expansion at all? (`exemptions.md` A)
skills.description_zh: 非官方指南按原文所述2027年开始、适用于19至64岁Medicaid Expansion成人的弗吉尼亚州联邦工作要求，逐题先检查排除和例外，初筛是否可能适用；该时间年龄属于源说明，未在本目录核验现行政策。

skills.name: hours-tracker
skills.description: Logs a Virginia Medicaid Expansion member's monthly work, school, volunteer and training hours or income against the federal work requirement thresholds, shows which months meet it, and builds a checklist of records to keep before renewal. Use when someone wants to track hours or income for the Virginia Medicaid work requirement, check whether a month qualifies, or prepare for a six-month renewal.
headings: Hours tracker: Virginia Medicaid work requirement
Before you start: read the references
skills.description_zh: 记录弗吉尼亚州Medicaid Expansion成员每月工作、学习、志愿和培训时数或收入，对照源指南工作要求门槛，标出符合月份并准备续期记录清单，支持六个月续期准备。

skills.name: notice-decoder
skills.description: Explains a letter from Virginia Medicaid (DMAS, Cover Virginia, Cardinal Care) or a local department of social services in plain language at about a 6th-grade reading level, covering what it's about, what it asks for, the deadline and the next step. Use when someone pastes or describes a Virginia Medicaid notice, renewal letter, request for information, or Notice of Adverse Action (denial or termination), especially about the work requirement.
headings: Notice decoder: Virginia Medicaid letters in plain language
Before you start: read the references
skills.description_zh: 用约小学六年级可读语言解释弗吉尼亚Medicaid、DMAS、Cover Virginia、Cardinal Care或社服部门通知，说明内容、要求、期限和下一步，涵盖续期、资料请求及拒绝终止通知。
